messages:
Samira Khan: Hey team, rented a car for client meetings in Milan. On return the card had 2 tolls (Autostrade) 28 total and a congestion zone charge 15 in city center for a detour I took for sightseeing with partner. Can I expense all? Receipt attached.

Tom (People Ops): Company covers tolls and congestion charges only for business travel/route. Personal detours should be split. Short: claim business portion and attach receipts + manager attestation.

Samira Khan: Ugh I forgot to get manager sign-off before the detour. Do I need retro approval?

Tom (People Ops): Retro manager approval is fine for small things. If the personal portion > 100 or looks like a pattern we may ask for more detail.

Priya (Finance): For tolls we prefer vendor receipts. If toll booths give a barcode slip, upload that. If tolls are charged via plate or aggregator and you only have a statement line, upload the rental invoice showing tolls and add manager note. We convert using the card rate on the statement.

Samira Khan: The rental company charged a single line item "road charges" and a rental invoice pdf lists 43. I can flag the 15 as personal. How should I pro-rate? Days? trips?

Liam (Travel Ops): Pro-rate by trip legs is reasonable here. You did 2 client legs and 1 personal detour, so allocate 2/3 business. In practice: claim 2/3 of the toll package (43 * 2/3 = 28.67) and 1/3 personal. Add a short note: "2/3 business legs (client meetings), 1/3 personal detour; approved by [manager name]".

Priya (Finance): Also tag expenses: use "rental-car" for base and "tolls" for charges. If the rental invoice is a bundled charge with no itemization, attach the invoice and a screenshot of the route or itinerary if helpful.

Expense Bot: Reminder: upload original rental invoice and any toll receipts. If the toll provider issues an invoice in company name and VAT is shown, we can reclaim VAT; otherwise mark non-VAT reclaimable.

Samira Khan: Thanks. Manager approved retro @Raj (via DM). I'll submit with 2/3 claim and attach invoice + manager attestation.

Tom (People Ops): Sounds good. Quick policy note: company pays tolls and parking when incurred for client work; personal extras must be split. Preapproval for planned personal detours that affect cost is required. Link: <https://redwood.company/policies/expenses#transportation>.

Priya (Finance): Received once submitted  will process with pro-rate and conversion. If accounting needs more detail we'll ping you.
